name: Rengo
source:
A young "mushitsukai" who escaped from the village and abandoned his clan. Now he lives in an old dilapidated warehouse doing shady jobs for [url=/c56452]Nishi[/url].

During one of his duels, he gets into an accident which subsequently kills [url=/c14598]Yumemi’s[/url] parents. He decides to kidnap her to breed more insects and satisfy his sadistic urges, but something unexpected happens…

[Based on the [url=https://www.cyc-soft.com/b-cyc-pro/extra/cha/extra_cha_01_2_1.htm]official description[/url]]
